selection: Optional validated inclusive UTF-8 key intervals select one exact generation. Independently supplied identity, generation and interval bind provider-produced continuations. A validated after-key can seek within that exact selection without creating a retained session. Neither mechanism establishes frozen application scope or proves position existence.
allocation: A caller may lower the encoded payload budget within the existing maximum. Providers inspect scalar lengths before cloning or loading payloads. A first valid value that cannot fit returns SpaceInsufficient; exhaustion after admitted records returns a continuation. Metadata remains separately bounded by count plus one lookahead. Callers charge decoding, intermediate buffers and product work within their own envelope.
consistency: Key ranges use bounded BTreeMap selection or SQLite primary-key predicates. Source-bound reads retain the exact canonical source, Ready health, registered promoted generation and expected-active checks under the same existing transaction or lock.
corruption: Keep explicit bounded corrupt-record locators for invalid stored values; invalid key/generation prevents safe continuation. No malformed record or oversized valid value becomes empty complete success.
compatibility: Default queries preserve the original full inventory, ordering, byte maximum and corruption rules. Historical v1 contract, stored bytes, migrations, features, dependencies and unsupported-provider refusals remain unchanged.
